title: Project profitability
periodNote: UTC · up to 367 calendar days. Revenue and expenses use their recorded date; time uses its start date and full recorded duration.
forbidden: Your role cannot view internal project finances.
retry: Check the dates or select a shorter period, then try again.
setup: Set the reporting currency and estimated hourly cost below to prepare this report.
incomplete: The result is incomplete. Review missing costs, unfinished or inaccessible time entries, and revenue in other currencies below.
formula: Estimated profit = recorded project revenue − expenses − estimated labor cost. Only revenue explicitly linked to this project is included. This report is not an accounting statement.
unbilledValue: Unbilled value with a recorded rate
unbilledNote: Unbilled time is not added to revenue. Billing links come from the tracked-time invoice workflow; older invoices may not have these links.
unpriced: {{hours}} unbilled hours have no billing rate.
unfinished: {{count}} time entries are unfinished or have invalid durations.
hidden: Some task time is outside your access. The project total cannot be completed.
otherCurrencies: Revenue excluded from this currency (no conversion)
settingsNote: One estimated labor cost per hour applies to all included time. Changing these assumptions recalculates all periods; it does not change historical payments or time entries.
confirm: I confirm that project expenses and time billing rates are recorded in this currency. No currency conversion will be applied.
settingsError: Could not save. Check the currency code and a nonnegative cost with up to two decimals.
